recipe.visualDefinition: A square-format, high-grain black and white portrait utilizing a double exposure technique to overlay two distinct poses of the same subject. One layer shows a direct gaze, while the second layer features a hand covering the forehead, creating a ghost-like transparency and a sense of internal movement.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between deep black clothing and mid-tone skin
Alignment of the central eye across both exposures
Texture of film grain unifying the disparate layers
coreInvariants: Square composition within a white border
Soft-focus edges on the secondary exposure

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame with a medium close-up crop.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The sharpest eye of the primary exposure, located near the vertical center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the vertical line of the hand downward to the beard, then cycles through the transparent secondary face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: A large white border surrounds the square image, with a neutral, flat grey background within the photo itself.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-grey tones for skin and background
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure black for the sweater and deep shadows
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for the external border and highlights on jewelry
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value range from deep blacks to bright whites with a heavy emphasis on textured mid-tones.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a black and white portrait of a man with a beard and tattoos, using a double exposure effect where two poses are layered with 50% transparency. Apply heavy film grain and a square crop.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place the square image in the center of a larger white canvas to create a wide border effect.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Are there two distinct but overlapping facial positions?
Is the grain texture prominent across the entire image?

adjustableVariables: Width of the white outer border
mustRedesign: Ensure the subject is a generic model to avoid likeness issues

mustAchieve: Seamless blending of the two exposures
avoid: Pure white background within the photo frame

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the double exposure doesn't look like a digital 'ghost' filter
recipe.reuseFormula: Square B&W Portrait + Double Exposure Overlay + Heavy Film Grain + White Border Frame
